prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a deep ebony-brown complexion, late 30s goddess, black glamour physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; a dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist; gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear; her head looks small on top of her massive body; not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, wolf cut rose pink hair — wearing a skin-tight micro school uniform set, a micro bikini top of two tiny triangle cups of ultra-thin matte crisp white modal jersey with thin navy piping, held by thin navy strings tied behind her neck and back, with a small gold crest bead between the cups, her shoulders, arms and midriff bare, and a micro pleated skirt of ultra-thin matte pale-blue modal jersey with a thin navy stripe along the hem, sitting at the top of her hip bones with a plain ultra-high slit up the right side from the hem to her hip bone, with the hem ending just below her hip bones. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small beauty mark near her lips and a small mole near her collarbone. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin modal jersey molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the soft matte drape of the white modal jersey against her bare shoulders and the crisp pleats of the skirt, fine stretch lines and a soft powdery matte finish. Pose: standing full height, both arms slightly spread commanding the frame — most extreme black glamour silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of glossy pale blue leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in pale blue lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, and a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: slender upswept willow-leaf brows, a fine red floral huadian mark painted on the forehead, softly flushed rosy cheeks, an upswept eyeliner tail, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a small vivid red lip.

Background: a grand palace hall with a wide marble staircase of standard steps, gilded waist-high balustrades and tall windows full of daylight, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
